summary_en: Period-end dividend for FY3/27 (year ending March 2027) revised upward. EPS raised to Y268.54 from undisclosed prior forecast, following strong Q1 results (Y85.31 per share vs. Y54.30 forecast) driven by Middle East-linked demand surge in electrical and pipe materials. Full-year sales now forecast at Y48,530M, operating profit Y6,232M, net income Y4,342M.
title_en: Notice Regarding Difference between Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Actual Results; Revision of Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Mirai Industry has issued a notice amending its consolidated earnings forecast and dividend guidance for the fiscal year ending March 2027 (FY3/27), filed 23 July 2026.

Q1 FY3/27 (ended 20 June 2026) actual results significantly exceeded forecast. Sales reached Y12,764M vs. forecast Y11,820M (+8.0%); operating profit Y1,945M vs. forecast Y1,290M (+50.8%); and net income attributable to parent Y1,379M vs. forecast Y877M (+57.1%), translating to EPS of Y85.31 vs. forecast Y54.30. The company attributed the outperformance to heightened defensive-demand procurement in electrical and pipe materials driven by rising geopolitical risk in the Middle East, which pushed Q1 sales and all profit metrics to record highs.

Based on improved visibility post-Q1, the company now publishes full-year FY3/27 forecasts previously marked "undisclosed" due to Middle East volatility. Full-year sales forecast Y48,530M; operating profit Y6,232M; net income Y4,342M; EPS Y268.54. The company expects H2 housing and construction demand to remain subdued and raw-material input costs to remain elevated, though it plans price adjustments to mitigate margin pressure. The period-end dividend for FY3/27 has been revised upward by board decision on 23 July 2026, though the new yen-per-share amount is not stated in the excerpt provided.
